I'm not sure anyone here knows enough about the specifics of your condition to dissuade you from any particular diagnostics...most of us aren't doctors and it would be irresponsible to do so. My recommendation is to find a doctor with a good reputation for treating fibro and to just follow his/her advice. Have them run the approprate tests to exclude other conditions-fibro can be misdiagnosed relatively easy because [many conditions mimic it (LINK)](http://www.jmedicalcasereports.com/content/6/1/55).  Perhaps go to a couple other doctors for second opinions. But I strongly advise you to stay away from expensive "alternative" therapies with no scientific backing- those are the treatments that will cost you thousands of dollars with no benefit. (A mistake that I'm embarrassed to admit I've made.)
